objective_contribution: Recover completed GLM-5.3-flash 8K outcomes with exhaustive terminal feedback while keeping every failed and corrective model token inside the unchanged cap.

question_and_hypotheses.question: Can one additional exhaustive terminal correction close the state valid-completion gap without changing the state treatment or token cap?

measurement_mapping.native: Use the full scheduled zero-filled denominator for the fixed development rule; also report complete native pairs and every missing or invalid outcome.
measurement_mapping.retention: Confirmed delivery, actual displacement, exact model-facing presentation and independently scored later evidence use remain required.
measurement_mapping.integrity: Verify exhaustive diagnostics, at most two corrections, no repository effect, exact result and ancestry bindings, no reruns and global shared stops.
measurement_mapping.tokens: Count every prefix, failed terminal response and correction input plus output token under the unchanged 96,000 cap.
measurement_mapping.transfer: A bounded diagnostic correction is reusable infrastructure; one exposed GLM 8K round does not prove larger-window, model, domain, correctness or confirmation transfer.

acceptance_and_scope.window_order: Finish the GLM small-window chapter before larger windows, other models, or domains.
acceptance_and_scope.exposure: Same exposed eight-task cohort. Round 20 is immutable historical evidence. Reserved confirmation remains untouched.
acceptance_and_scope.stopping_rules: No task, state, prompt, order, context/output/total-token cap, scorer, threshold, source refresh or favorable rerun change. Only the maximum terminal corrections changes from one to two.

retained_counterevidence: Round 20 accounted all 56 cells but only 18/24 pairs had native scores in both arms.
Six task-5 branches were retained as prefix-ineligible because the prefix terminated before treatment exposure.
Three terminal outcomes were invalid after one correction: two state and one control.
State valid completions were 19 versus 20 control, missing the non-degradation gate.
Four task-6 recycled generations lacked a model-facing state presentation.
Scheduled zero-filled span gain was +0.0528348799 and file gain +0.1069444444.
State used 107,102 fewer cumulative branch model tokens; physical known total was 2,381,108 with zero unknown usage.
Native evidence selection does not establish repair correctness, semantic retention, transfer, confirmation or clearance.
successor_rule: Prove two-correction recovery and a third-rejection stop offline, then freeze and run every Round 21 identity once. Count all failed and corrective tokens and retain missingness. Review H32 separately from H25. Every successor must pass policy v4 exact-value continuity.

criterion_verdicts.enduring_objective: The selected mechanism targets more completed outcomes while charging every added model token.
criterion_verdicts.initial_GLM_objective: GLM-5.3-flash remains at the 8K small-window chapter.
criterion_verdicts.current_milestone: The full fixed ContextBench contract remains unchanged and uncleared; the immediate gate is the accounted 24-pair development denominator.
criterion_verdicts.method_and_predecessor: Reviewed Round 20 results yield competing H32, H33, H25 and H0; H32 directly addresses the one-result validity deficit.
criterion_verdicts.counterevidence: All missing pairs, invalid outcomes, exposure gaps, heterogeneous effects and scope limits remain explicit.
criterion_verdicts.measurement_and_token_cost: Native quality, terminal validity, retention, integrity, transfer and every model input/output token remain separate.
criterion_verdicts.scope_and_acceptance: The exposed cohort remains separate from reserved confirmation and the full 1,136-identity acceptance run.
criterion_verdicts.testability: Exactly two corrections may dispatch, a third invalid response stops, full diagnostics persist and all token and effect rules are directly falsifiable.
